market_outlook: Equities open June on cautiously bullish footing with S&P futures +0.22% and Nasdaq +0.25% in pre-market. The dominant macro catalyst is US-Iran ceasefire optimism — oil has plunged ~20% from 2026 highs on Strait of Hormuz deal prospects, which is broadly deflationary and supportive for consumer/tech. Sector rotation remains in play with industrials, energy, and defensives having led YTD, but AI-driven tech names like MU are roaring back and threatening to reclaim leadership; the backdrop favors high-quality momentum names and Sentinel-confirmed insider buys over crowded value cyclicals.

watchlist.thesis: STRONG BUY Sentinel signal — 4 insiders buying (score=102, including Montemayor, Walters, Pitesa). VST reported Q1 revenue +43% YoY to $5.64B and reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance of $6.8B-$7.6B. Nuclear fleet + Meta PPA + ERCOT/PJM dominance makes VST the premier AI power-demand beneficiary. Analyst consensus is Strong Buy (19 Buy/0 Hold/1 Sell) with median PT implying ~61% upside. Ex-dividend June 22 adds a near-term catalyst. Stock pulled back ~9% over 10 days — insider cluster buy at current levels is a high-conviction entry signal.

Micron surged 304% YTD and joined the $1T market cap club. Trading at $971 today (+5.14%), with Q2 FY2026 revenue of $23.86B (+196% YoY) and 58% profit margins. Q3 guidance calls for $33.5B revenue. Earnings on June 24 are the next monster catalyst — analysts are calling for skyrocket post-earnings. Trump publicly endorsed MU's $200B domestic fab investment, raising potential for additional CHIPS Act equity investment. Forward P/E of just 11x vs industry 31x means this is still cheap despite the run. Pre-earnings momentum play with defined June 24 catalyst.

Leveraged call into the June 24 earnings catalyst. MU is at $971 and has a history of trouncing estimates. Management pre-guided positively at last call. UBS PT of $1,650 implies massive upside. A $1,000 strike call expiring just after earnings captures the post-print move with defined risk. AI memory demand exceeds supply — earnings surprise risk is heavily skewed to the upside.

Fresh Sentinel signal — Director Brian Hannasch bought 165 shares at $2,987 on May 29 ($492,855) right at the 52-week low after AZO dropped 11.7% post-earnings. Insider buying near multi-year lows after a sentiment flush is a classic contrarian entry. Citi, Jefferies, Raymond James all maintain Buy ratings. Q3 domestic SSS +4.1% shows business is healthy — drop was valuation reset, not fundamental deterioration. Net sales +8.4% YoY. Risk/reward compelling with multiple buy-rated analysts and $3,700+ price targets.

Already in portfolio at avg $17.34, currently $15.55 (-10%). Hold and trail stop to protect gains. Consider selling covered calls at $215-$220 strike to harvest premium while holding the position.

Covered call against existing 41-share TKO position. Stock is up $778 unrealized. Selling the $220 call (~6% OTM) harvests premium income while allowing further upside. If called away at $220, that locks in $31/share gain (~16% return) plus premium. Protects against mean reversion in a stock that has run hard.

RGTI is in portfolio at avg $25.11 (1,344 shares, ~$33.7K position). Stock is volatile at $24.77 but showing renewed momentum — currently $25.54 per June 1 reporting, with 100+ qubit Lyra system launch in late 2026 and $100M CHIPS Act grant as catalysts. However, RGTI still burns $26M/quarter operationally despite 200% revenue growth to $4.4M. RSI was 77-81 recently — overbought. Trim 25-30% of position (~336 shares) on any pop to $26-$27 to lock in partial profit and reduce concentration. Hold rest for the Lyra launch catalyst.

Iran ceasefire talks are driving oil prices down sharply — Brent fell to $92.56, down 19% in May. XOM has pulled back with crude but remains fundamentally strong (+22% YTD before the pullback). Selling cash-secured puts at $110 (~6-8% OTM) collects premium while the market prices in peace optimism. If XOM stabilizes as ceasefire deal is struck, puts expire worthless. If filled, get long XOM at a discount with strong energy fundamentals.
